scope: Expand native foundation discovery from seven to eight test-bearing packages by including the installed runtime command

selectionChange.name: runtime-command
selectionChange.limits: The normal collector selects all ordinary command-package tests on both native hosts. Darwin runtime refusal filtering and the separate four-image/three-host install selections remain unchanged.

collectorControls.limits: Synthetic collector tests on Windows, not actual native macOS execution. Missing or non-test-bearing runtime command records are refused; both simulated host runs execute its full package exactly once.

actualLinuxChecks.limits: Actual Go inventory and command-package tests only. The other seven suites were not executed by this run. No Docker resources, installed host processes or native macOS tests were started.

independentReview.result: Exact collector/workflow source review closed. Runtime command coverage is required and unfiltered on both normal host selections; prior admission and timeout boundaries remain intact.
independentReview.limits: Source review only; no independent rerun or native execution by the reviewer.

The historical seven-package source review remains history, not acceptance of the new eight-package selection. Earlier 31-control and two-host-test records remain unchanged.
